title: Quick Accent - Auto select accent when press and hold
author: riccarreghi

status.label: actionable design
status.detail: The requested press-and-hold selection behavior is bounded, no exact duplicate was found, and current code deliberately starts with no selection until a navigation trigger occurs.

next_action.label: Queue a full design investigation; keep design_in_progress until interaction and release semantics are verified.
next_action.reason: Queue a full design investigation; keep design_in_progress until interaction and release semantics are verified.

judgment.rationale: The requested press-and-hold selection behavior is bounded, no exact duplicate was found, and current code deliberately starts with no selection until a navigation trigger occurs.
evidence: The report asks only for the first accent to be selected when the press-and-hold popup opens.
Issues #20429 and #44452 concern hold activation and number shortcuts, not automatic initial selection.
PowerAccent.Core initializes _selectedIndex to -1 and selects an item only when Space or an arrow trigger is processed.
judgment.recommended_action: Queue a full design investigation; keep design_in_progress until interaction and release semantics are verified.

issue_context.summary: Quick Accent press-and-hold opens the accent row without a selected item; the proposal is to preselect the first item so release can choose it without another navigation key.
known_information: The issue contains a specific interaction and expected convenience benefit.
Current PowerAccent state starts at selected index -1.
StartSelectionFromTheLeft affects the first navigation trigger, not popup-open initialization.
inferences: Automatically selecting on popup-open could make releasing the held letter commit an accent; this must be confirmed against false-start behavior.
issue_context.analysis: The request maps to a small state-machine change, but the design must establish whether selection is visual-only or changes release output and accessibility announcements.
initial_investigation: Reviewed PowerAccent.Core/PowerAccent.cs and PowerAccentKeyboardService press-and-hold handling.
Searched related issues; #20429 and #44452 are adjacent ideas rather than exact duplicates.

information_gaps.information: Required release behavior after automatic preselection
information_gaps.why_needed: Determines whether a highlight change would also insert an accent when the user merely holds and releases a letter.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Resolve during full design against current press-and-hold tests and product interaction expectations.
